Time]] | utc = UTC−04:00 }} '''La Isabela International Airport''' {{Airport codes|JBQ|MDJB}} is a minor [[international airport]] in the [[Dominican Republic]], serving as a secondary airport for [[Santo Domingo]]. ==History== The airport opened on 23 February 2006 to replace [[Herrera International Airport]].[http://www.aerodom.com/2005/aeropuertos_laisabela.htm www.aerodom.com] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070703042422/http://www.aerodom.com/2005/aeropuertos_laisabela.htm |date=2007-07-03 }} The first flight to land at the airport was a [[Caribair]] flight from [[Port-au-Prince]], [[Haiti]].http://www.clavedigital.com/Portada/Articulo.asp?Id_Articulo=6964{{dead link|date=December 2017 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} ==Operations== It primarily serves the [[Dominican Republic]] with domestic flights and international flights to other Caribbean islands. La Isabela Airport is a hub for Dominican airlines that operate small aircraft. The airport has the largest number of hangars in the country (+40) for Dominican-based carriers. It is, as of June 2020, also the only airport in Santo Domingo that serves domestic destinations, as [[Las Americas International Airport]], the Santo Domingo's larger, main airport, lacks domestic air service.{{cn|date=December 2024}} == Airlines and destinations == {{Airport destination list | {{nowrap|[[Air Century]]{{cn|date=December 2024}}}} | [[Queen Beatrix International Airport|Aruba]], [[Ernesto Cortissoz International Airport|Barranquilla]], [[Rafael Núñez International Airport|Cartagena]],{{cite web|url=https://aeroroutes.com/eng/220610-y2aug22ctg|title=Air Century adds Cartagena service from August 2022|publisher=AeroRoutes|date=June 10, 2022|accessdate=June 11, 2022}} [[Curaçao International Airport|Curaçao]], [[José Martí International Airport|Havana]], [[Toussaint Louverture International Airport|Port-au-Prince]], [[Antonio Maceo Airport|Santiago de Cuba]], [[Princess Juliana International Airport|Sint Maarten]] | {{nowrap|[[Sunrise Airways]]}} | [[Toussaint Louverture International Airport|Port-au-Prince]][https://www.sunriseairways.net/en/destinations sunriseairways.net - Destinations] retrieved 22 December 2024 }} ==Statistics== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="font-size: 95%;" |+ '''Top Routes from La Isabela
